title: Ribmaul

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Weapon used to attack Goblins or Skeletons.

body:
Ribmaul

The Ribmaul is a weapon that can be found in the Acidlands, it can be used to fight mobs and drops exclusively from the Skeleton King. The attack is similar to that of the Rust breaker with heavy knockback and damage but a high cooldown, it deals slightly more damage. The large size of the weapon makes it great for clearing swarms of mobs quickly.

Although the drop chance is unknown it's estimated to have a drop chance of about 20%. Or about 1 in 5 kills (1/5). Similar to that of the BIG Skull.

Trivia

-It is the largest weapon added to the game so far.

-Due to the other items dropped from the Skeleton King such as BIG Bones, BIG Skulls, and Acid Crowns it can be a decent source of income, especially if one sells the Ribmaul, BIG skulls, Acid Crowns and other skeleton drops to other players or as a side income while trying to get Skeleon Trophies
